title: Video Chests
intro: The Video Chest is a bonus type of chest available once a day by watching Video Ads. Like any other chest, multiple Video Chests can be collected over time without opening them.
content_body: The Video Chest contains all the items found in a Normal (coin) chest, including shop animals and legendary (yellow) puzzle pieces.
availability_body: You can find the Video Chest under the standard "Chest" tab in the right drop-down menu. It appears there once you enable video ads in the Game Settings by unticking the "Don't show video offers" checkbox. Make sure not to tick the option to hide ads while collecting coins from admission booths, as this will deactivate the setting.
limit_body: You can receive only one Video Chest every 24 hours. Since video chests are earned rather than purchased, they do not have a storage limit.
platform_body: Video Chests are available only to users playing the game through the app on Android or iOS. They are not available on devices that do not support ads or on certain platforms such as Steam, Epic Games, or Amazon.
